caption: Tissue identity structures the adult transcriptome, and the testes are the most transcriptionally specialized tissue.
The maternal-to-zygotic transition unfolds as three sequential phases of gene expression.
Sexual dimorphism is concentrated in the germline, not the soma.
Mating remodels the ovary, not the soma, and each reproductive compartment responds independently.
The testes are the most male-defining tissue, and a small germline-soma-shared gene set marks candidate sex-linked loci.
